newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks seen stable, pulp makers rallying.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks seen stable, pulp makers rallying.

text.p: Chilean stocks opened steady and are seen remaining flat for the rest of the day, although the forestry sector is likely to rally on signs of rising wood pulp prices, said traders.
"Natural resource (stocks) are doing well. There are reports in the press of rising pulp prices," said David Hurd, head of research at Merrill Lynch.
Copec, Chile's largest pulp producer, and paper maker CMPC, which both rallied last week, are seen continuing to firm on the higher prices, he said.
The index opened up 0.07 percent at 131.72 points.
The bourse is seen generally trading sideways for the week as investors wait for company first half results which should start filtering into the market mid-July, said traders.
"I don't see brokers taking positions until the results are out," said one dealer.
Early risers included power investment company Enersis which firmed 0.7 percent to 288 pesos. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
